entries.8f0ca98e437cb175: This is the group's largest business, centered on House Foods Corporation, which manufactures and sells curry roux, stew roux, retort foods, spices and other products. In household products, sales of curry roux and stew roux recovered, and channel-specific sales measures in the business-use market also proved effective. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥126,812 million.
entries.928ed1b7b78010c1: This business operates curry restaurants under the "CoCo ICHIBANYA" brand in Japan and overseas, centered on [[company:ichibanya|ICHIBANYA CO.,LTD.]]. In Japan, sales grew due to sales measures following the price revision and business expansion at domestic subsidiaries. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥65,393 million.
entries.95136411387d0fce: This business engages in import and export sales of food ingredients, transportation and other operations. Vōkusu Torēdingu Co., Ltd. handles import and export sales of food ingredients, and House Logistics Service Co., Ltd. handles transportation and other operations. Delica Chef Co., Ltd., which had been engaged in side dishes and desserts, has been excluded from the scope of consolidation since January 15, 2026, following the transfer of its shares. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥45,418 million.

entries.aaae09f6aa8375a5: Under the Eighth Medium-Term Management Plan, the company aims for growth by building a global structure across three value chains (spice-based, soy-based and functional-ingredient-based), as the second chapter of its transformation into a quality company of “Health through food.” Stating that growth in revenue and improvements in capital efficiency have lagged as of the end of the 80th fiscal period, the company says it will push structural reforms built on three pillars: concentrating management resources on growth areas, organizational reform to realize its growth strategy, and strengthening its financial strategy.
